layout.name: Radar Chart
layout.layoutData:
<# var msg = tw.resource.toolkit.TWSYS.ChartMessages; #>

chart {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	backgroundPaint : "#ffffffff";
	border : "@#border10";
	header : "@#label7";
	labels[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.radialAxis1.text") #>";
	labels[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.radialAxis2.text") #>";
	labels[2] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.radialAxis3.text") #>";
	labels[3] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.radialAxis4.text") #>";
	labels[4] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.radialAxis5.text") #>";
	labels[5] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.radialAxis6.text") #>";
	legendPosition : "South";
	legendVisible : "true";
	name : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.name") #>";
	opaque : "true";
	preferredSize : "414,364";
	renderingType : "COMBO";
	sampleSeries[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.lineSet1.text") #>,80,68,78,84,66,70:LINE";
	sampleSeries[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.lineSet2.text") #>,45,95,95,48,60,42:LINE";
	sampleSeries[2] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.lineSet3.text") #>,120,10,10,10,10,10:LINE";
	type : "RADAR";
}

chartGrid[axisIndex="-1"] {
	majorPaint : "#ff000000";
	majorStroke : "@#stroke4";
}

chartGrid[axisIndex="0"] {
	majorLineVisible : "false";
}

chartLegend {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	border : "@#border9";
	followChartResize : "true";
	font : "SansSerif,10";
	foreground : "black";
	paintingBackground : "false";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] {
	autoDataRange : "true";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	labelColor : "#ff000000";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	labelVisible : "true";
	titleColor : "#ff000000";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
	reversed : "true";
}



chartScale[axisIndex="0"] {
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	labelColor : "#ff000000";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-9";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "false";
	titleColor : "#ff000000";
}

series[index="0"] {
	color1 : "#5a005699";
	color2 : "#FF005699";
	marker : "DIAMOND";
	markerSize : "8";
	renderingType : "AREA";
	stroke : "@#stroke1";
}

series[index="1"] {
	color1 : "#5a333366";
	color2 : "#FF333366";
	marker : "SQUARE";
	markerSize : "5";
	renderingType : "AREA";
	stroke : "@#stroke2";
}

series[index="2"] {
	color1 : "#5aaa0036";
	color2 : "#FFaa0036";
	marker : "TRIANGLE";
	markerSize : "8";
	renderingType : "AREA";
	stroke : "@#stroke3";
}

Subobject#border10 {
	bottom : "4";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "4";
	right : "4";
	top : "4";
}

}

}

	top : "1";
}

Subobject#label5 {
	border : "@#border6";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-12";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.Radar.header") #>";
}

Subobject#label7 {
	border : "@#border8";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-12";

	horizontalAlignment : "0";

}
